role: Regional Director, Bureau of Outdoor Recreation, Lake Central Region
stance_basis: explicitly states opinion aligns with Mr. Davis but clarifies it is technical assistance only and does not represent the Department of the Interior's position
summary: John D. Cherry, Regional Director of the Bureau of Outdoor Recreation, Lake Central Region, responded to a request regarding the Section 4(f) involvement of the Roosevelt School property. His opinion aligned with that of Mr. Davis (Benjamin O. Davis, Jr., Department of Transportation) but he explicitly noted it was provided only as technical assistance and did not represent the official position of the Department of the Interior. He also indicated that the proper person to make a determination of recreation significance would be the Director of the Park District for Chicago Heights.
complaint_summary: Cherry states that his opinion aligns with Mr. Davis's but is provided only as technical assistance and does not represent the Department of the Interior's official position, and that the proper person to determine recreation significance is the Director of the Park District for Chicago Heights.
